 Ishita Rathi IAS: UPSC Rank, Cadre, Education, Age and Current Posting
 By Santosh Suman - October 24, 2026 Share Facebook X WhatsApp Linkedin Email Telegram 
 Ishita Rathi IAS 
 Ishita Rathi IAS Biography: Ishita Rathi is an Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the 2022 batch, allotted to the AGMUT cadre. She secured All India Rank (AIR) 8 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2021 .
 She holds a bachelor’s degree in Economics from Lady Shri Ram College, University of Delhi, and a master’s degree in Economics from the Madras School of Economics. She was serving as Sub Collector (Revenue), North, Puducherry, before being relieved for a new assignment in Jammu and Kashmir in September 2026.
 In October 2026, the Jammu and Kashmir administration posted her as Additional Deputy Commissioner, Jammu. The official Jammu district website lists her as Additional District Magistrate, Jammu.

 Education and UPSC Selection 
 Ishita Rathi completed her graduation in Economics from Lady Shri Ram College, University of Delhi, and her master’s degree in Economics from the Madras School of Economics in Chennai. She cleared the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2021 with AIR 8 and entered the IAS through direct recruitment.
 In interviews published after the UPSC result, Rathi said she prepared primarily through online study material and did not take coaching. The 2021 examination was her third attempt.

 Family and Personal Background 
 Ishita Rathi is from Delhi. Her father, I. S. Rathi, is a head constable in Delhi Police, and her mother, Meenakshi Rathi, is an assistant sub-inspector in Delhi Police.
 Her exact date of birth has not been included because it could not be independently confirmed from an accessible official record.
